observations: Original runner acquired a slot after 147s, ran all four variants and wrote its complete journal and canonical report.
Launcher then emitted command not found: ne and acquired again after 833s.
The unintended second runner invocation failed immediately with EEXIST on the existing journal; it executed no native variants.
cause: Shared Zsh helper was extended in place during the child run. Its modified tail was reread after the original child returned. Minimal reproduction confirms tail reexecution for file-based launch and single execution for captured-text launch.
mitigation: Future launches evaluate an immutable text snapshot of the coordinator-provided helper with zsh -c. The same shared slot directories, cap-file logic and command arguments are preserved; no coordinator file changed.
followup: Validate the launcher correction on the next ordinary selection; do not repeat or overwrite the completed arguments observations.
